summary: Verified and triaged 3 security findings from identified hypotheses and systemic risks.

findings.title: Privilege Escalation via Unknown Root Contract
findings.description: CONFIRMED: An attacker might bypass State Transition Integrity by exploiting uninitialized state or missing modifiers in administrative functions.
findings.mitigation: Trace all 'onlyOwner' or similar access control paths in Unknown Root Contract.

findings.title: Internal Accounting Desync in Unknown Root Contract
findings.description: CONFIRMED: External token transfers might cause internal state balances to desync from actual contract holdings, potentially locking or draining funds.
findings.mitigation: Review ERC20 'transfer' and 'transferFrom' return value handling and balance checkpoints.

findings.title: Oracle Price Manipulation
findings.description: ECONOMIC RISK CONFIRMED: Reliance on spot price or narrow-window TWAP from decentralized exchanges can be exploited via flash loans.
findings.mitigation: Use decentralized oracle aggregators (e.g. Chainlink) with circuit breakers.
